abstract: Ruptured benign cystic teratomas of the ovary mimicking gynecologic malignancy are uncommon, but frequently misdiagnosed. Two cases are reported that, preoperatively, were believed to represent ovarian carcinoma, but were found to have diffuse granulomatous peritonitis, secondary to perforation of the teratomas. Intra-abdominal adhesions and/or masses are frequent sequelae. A diagnosis of malignancy must be confirmed prior to performing radical surgery. A review of the literature is presented.
abstract_ja: 婦人科悪性腫瘍を模倣する、破裂した卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫はまれであるが、しばしば誤診される。術前に卵巣癌と考えられた2例を報告する。両例とも、奇形腫の穿孔に起因するびまん性肉芽腫性腹膜炎が見つかった。腹腔内癒着や腫瘤は頻繁に続発する。根治的手術を行う前に、悪性腫瘍の診断を確定しなければならない。文献的考察を併せて示す。
